notes.title: NUSNUR DEMO Is Out & Chapter 2 News
notes.content:
- DEMO IS OUT -
The DEMO is now available on Steam for anyone to try the game for free!

What is up with the DEMO?

The DEMO ends after a portion of Chapter 1 is played.
Nimbus’s universe features hack-and-slash and turn-based battle mechanics, both of which are available to try in the DEMO.
Achievements are included in the DEMO, however they will not count toward Steam achievements.
Switching from the DEMO to the full game will keep your progress. However, we don’t recommend switching from the full game back to the DEMO, as it may erase your progress after future updates.
The DEMO will not receive updates unless a critical bug is found.

- MEET OPHELIA -
Chapter 2 will feature Ophelia and Yuzuki as main characters, along with Nusnur Supreme, Kazuya, Nii-san, Anurnia, and more...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/e93cdd60d09fb88fc5946e53885d6812f209a783.gif

Get ready for a scary adventure...
She was just trying to survive back in her universe... Now she has to survive even more! Anyway, what's up with all these playing cards?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/5df6ce4e74be050f46af8a6dac3deab99c57d942.gif

When though...?
Great question!
It may take some time, but we're still developing Chapter 2, and we'll keep you updated! In the meantime, let's take a moment to relax with Ophelia.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/39b24a4df1cf37ac46666439084eb71f579054e9.gif

Thank you for your interest and see you soon!

notes.title: 25/04/2025 - Cooperation Of Us - Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
A quick round of bug fixes and improvements to help you enjoy the co-op update to the fullest!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/37783bd99cdd92ef8b4d466fedb6b68507c8335b.png

Re-entering the co-op setup menu no longer resets your previous configuration.
Co-op individuals can no longer use the eye finisher in the co-op battle imagination.
Illusion bots no longer continue to exist after their owner has died.
Pressing the movement and attack buttons simultaneously while standing still will now cause you to jump forward and attack at the same time.
The orange eye passive ability no longer grants health when the "Cannot heal." modifier is active in the co-op battle imagination.
If 2 minutes pass in a room of the co-op battle imagination without a victory, all healing is disabled.
Every co-op individual can now use their cursor and emote after death in the co-op battle imagination.
Nimbus's attack range has been increased, allowing her to hit targets in the same spot as her.
The red eye passive ability now functions correctly even after the game speed has been changed.
The number of rounds in the co-op battle imagination can now be adjusted.
More modifiers have been added to the co-op battle imagination.
More rooms have been added to the co-op battle imagination.

notes.title: 23/04/2025 - Cooperation Of Us [CO-OP]
notes.content:
CO-OP UPDATE IS LIVE!
It has been a long and tedious development process, but the co-op feature is finally here! Any future content compatible with co-op will also support it.

> Get ready for an adventure with your friends across the universes of NUSNUR...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/6112306b916ac7d2f6027105fb0ba23e8e8312d8.gif

Local co-op for up to 4 individuals has been added.

> Sit back, relax, and observe NUSNUR in peak comfort...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/a90f1c5e6983fa4189dd47dd91ba3d81bf4ff8b7.gif

Co-op individuals can interact with the environment, but story progression is tied to the host.

> Team up with your friends and take down anything that gets in your way...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/f069ad900aa3fee8e05e029fa3d725968537b47b.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/f777dd6d0392f67c42c2e887aaf43ef6f71158ea.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/c2b749961c5572f1fb4a6e030947cd176bea315d.gif

Friendly fire, camera focus, and visuals can be customized in the co-op options menu.

> Don't forget to have fun along the way...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/c0128108cb1c5e0d4b152cf161d20ceb7b2e21ab.gif

Co-op individuals can use cursor emotes while spectating.

> Why not prove which one of you is the greatest eye magic warrior of all time...?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/d0589458bd52aca257c7087e470ce3d728ea6dcf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/4a579a6ed328126204a162c1f12db6da2ca88574.gif

An imagination where every co-op individual can battle has been added.
Different rooms and modifiers have been added to the co-op battle imagination.

> More small content and quality-of-life updates for observers are here...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/37783bd99cdd92ef8b4d466fedb6b68507c8335b.png

Epic Grid Game (EGG) universe imagination has been added.
Now, quick eye attack ability is available after the encounter with Qaan.
Falling no longer interrupts melee attacks.
The eye finisher attack no longer adopts the quick eye attack button if the quick eye attack is unavailable.
The default controller/gamepad key bindings have been updated to follow traditional usage.

> Something eerie is on its way...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/61bbc897ac3a16b960ef30b9dffecfdfb294f6df.gif
Thank you for [strike]playing[/strike] observing...

notes.title: 14/03/2025 - Language Support & Other News
notes.content:
What's uuup everyone! Nunu is here to drop the news!

Now everyone can speak ANY LANGUAGE you desire!

Added Turkish language.
Added the ability to add new languages.
Anyone can edit the language files inside the game folder to modify every single text in "observation"!
You can even make me meow all the time!!! 🐱
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/2329894d328c3d185f4423a0a9fab092147ab669.gif

Other than this epic update (which took way too long), observation is now even more optimized—so much so that you can use a toaster to observe everything! (Also, some strokes have been 'fixed' as well...)

Now, each OST is loaded into memory only if it is needed in the current episode.
Fixed some typos in the English language.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/6979593e0f1ba46a5f135ad8600f6ad735dabe14.png

Huh, you're wondering what happened to the new content update that will include Yuzuki?
It's still in development! They left me a note to read as well:
"Due to work and university-related workload, the development team is having a hard time working on the new content. Sorry!"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/4b30a9a63448b277c2950ecfb9a258d52b54ebd8.png

And here are some not-so-important changes:

Now, each time Nimbus dies in the same room, her damage multiplier increases. Once she leaves the room, the multiplier gradually decreases each time she enters a new one.
Buffed some turn-based combat skills, they are not that useless anymore!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/8e5b0670dbf932093353c862f2a3d211df1779ea.png

By the way...
If you want to officially add a new language option to the observation, feel free to reach out via our support e-mail: team.parafox@gmail.com !!!

BYE BYEEEE! MEOW! 🐱🐱🐱

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/8b8f4f9350bfde41fa7745d2265a05d71135f8d8.png

notes.title: 14/02/2025 - All Rework & More Fun
notes.content:
Good Day, everyone. Nunu isn't here today so I'm taking charge. Critical updates have been made, so I will get straight to the point.

It has come to our attention that some of the game features weren't properly introduced. Perhaps you noticed while Nimbus is cleaning uh... her house, if she "backstabbed" the bots she would do much more damage. In case you didn't, now you know.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/8cf43638adcdd87401fb22bc2e8a5c4de72277d8.gif

The other feature we... *cough* forgot... to introduce was, the shortcuts for spesific eye colors. While fighting for your life, it's hard to change the eye color using the mouse wheel. Now you can see which number indicates which eye color on the top left of the screen and straight up pick them without looking for it on the Color Ring.

Ah, before moving on... some visual effects are added to highlight important interactables such as levers and books so that you can track them easily.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/06d6bcd93b8fd6de16e206de9e44b7135b5325df.gif

Yeah we get it, white eye is the suuuupeeeriooor. But that's boring as- uh... now the ENTIRE skill set has been reworked. Feel free to try more combinations with other eye colors in any Illusion Battle instead of just picking the old, strongest white eye skill and energy recharge on loop, yikes. 

As for our next update.... *stares at the page blankly for a while* really? If that battle was THAT hard, Maybe you shouldn't have challenged me. *sigh* whatever, I guess The Imaginations can't be shackled. Keeping that in mind, maybe I can go a little bit easier on you. I have made the Void Eyes open a little bit slower so you can get more chances~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/84ebd91c9d41bd0a5912465884451c005c9d61ba.gif

Lastly, for the people who doesnt want to watch the same hit animation over and over again in Illusion fights, they are now fast-forwardable. Just hold any button after picking your actions.

Overall, these are the updates:

Backstab Double Damage tutorial has been added.
Numbered Eye Color Indicators have been added on the Color Ring. 
Important interactables are now highlighted.
ALL of the attacks used in the Illusion Battles have been reworked and their descriptions are simplified.
The Void Eye Attacks on Kazuya Imagination Battle has became slower.
The attack animations in Illusion Battles can be fast-forwarded.


Next time, be more prepared for my battle, will you~
~Kazuya

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330851/8a86be71c2738bcdd2d0540398236629c5830a9b.gif

notes.title: 10/02/2025 - Faster! Better! Easier?
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thank you for [strike]playing[/strike]— I mean, "observing"— NUSNUR and for providing your valuable feedback! We are currently developing a new content update. In the meantime, we wanted to release a quality-of-life update!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45330851/ac08c26b18d2f3cdea1808a6588ad7fef22c5b1d.png
Maybe you just wanted to focus on the story, or perhaps you didn’t feel like dealing with the gameplay itself—doesn’t matter! Now, you can make the gameplay easier if you want!

An option has been added to the menu that makes the gameplay sections of the game easier. Enabling this option will make certain achievements unobtainable and affect the following:

For hack-and-slash gameplay: Damage of Nimbus is doubled, and she has significantly more health and energy.
For turn-based combat gameplay: The player's team takes 50% less damage in many cases and sometimes receives special buffs, while the opposing team has special debuffs.
This option does not affect imagination challenges.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45330851/eece0a4730f396a80df538b55412f2e7f17e14fb.gif
You used the eye magic finisher, saw its animation, and said, "Hey, that's cool." Then you used it again and probably thought, "I wish I could skip it." Well, here you go!

Holding any button while eye magic finisher animation is playing will fast forward the animation.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45330851/ec25d5076306d4a7f773ba78c39e817d8b198eb2.gif
Whenever you used dashing to fall from somewhere, Nimbus would lose all her momentum. That wasn’t fun... Now, she keeps all the speed she can get!

Now, dashing towards the air will not reset momentum.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45330851/efe54dc34bba347dd1e79912bbe1428222ac4ac7.png
New content update that will feature Yuzuki and a new gameplay element in a different universe is coming soon! Language support is still in development and most probably release after the new content.

Once again, thank you for playing~
